hooks.command: f=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | sed 's|.*KevsBitchinPrintCalculator[/\\]||; s|\\|/|g'); if grep -q "'\./$f'" sw.js 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet HEAD -- sw.js 2>/dev/null; then echo "NOTE: $f is cached by the service worker but sw.js VERSION is unchanged. Bump it before deploying, or installed phones keep serving the old build." >&2; fi; exit 0

case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in *js/core/*) echo '--- core changed: running the hand-verified fixtures ---' >&2; node --test tests/sequence.test.js tests/layout.test.js tests/scores.test.js tests/measure.test.js tests/printable.test.js tests/count.test.js tests/placement.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (fail|pass)|^ℹ (pass|fail)|not ok' >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
